''See also: [[High Council (The Elder Empire: Shadow) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] is a three-member leadership body that serves as the voice of the [[Am’haranai]] and directs the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]]. Described by members as the architects and masons of [[The Empire|the Empire]], they view themselves as essential shepherds tasked with maintaining the realm's prosperity and guarding against chaos. The [[Council]] operates through various roles, including [[Architects]] and [[Gardeners]], and has historically collaborated with specialized groups like [[Readers]] and historians to make strategic decisions. While they have traditionally been known for their unwavering loyalty to the Emperor, recent political shifts following his death have led to internal conflict and controversial decisions regarding the succession of the [[throne]]. The [[Council]]'s primary objective is the containment of the [[Great Elders]], a threat they manage by attempting to prevent Elder corruption and considering the deployment of the [[Regents]] as warriors to defend humanity.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a group that holds the power to decide the [[Fate|fate]] of the world, the High [[Council]] operates with significant [[Authority|authority]] and secrecy. They sought to accelerate the assassination of the Emperor by tasking [[Shera]] with the deed ahead of its original schedule, and they may have possessed prior knowledge regarding the Emperor's own plans. To maintain control, the [[Council]] ordered the sealing of the chamber containing the [[coffins]] and exercised their right to execute any [[Consultants]] who disclose [[Guild]] secrets. Furthermore, they do not act in isolation when determining the status of individuals like [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] wanted [[Shera]] to kill the Emperor ahead of schedule.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] is a group that may have known about the Emperor's plan.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] ordered the room containing the [[coffins]] to be sealed up.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] did not make the decision regarding Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala's status alone.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] makes decisions about the [[Fate|fate]] of the world.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The High [[Council]] has the power to execute [[Consultants]] who reveal [[Guild]] secrets.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I have orders from the High Council,” she said, looking into his eyes with pleading.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Gardener Meia,” Shera said, in a mock-serious tone, “are you asking me to ignore the commands of the High Council?”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Do you trust Yala and the High Council to make better decisions about the fate of the world than the Emperor?”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
